feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Scientists map key protein interactions linked with profound autism
entry.summary: Research published in the journal Science illuminates a "missing piece" in the biological understanding of profound autism and offers new targets for drug development.

entry.title: Germany's far-right AfD party is poised for power in a state election
entry.summary: Germany's AfD's TikTok-fueled rise in Saxony-Anhalt is raising fears the country could see its first far-right governor since World War II.

entry.title: What app surged in downloads after Trump's 'Lake America' change? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus: George Santos is back in the news!

entry.title: Who owns the beach? A heated battle plays out in the Florida Panhandle
entry.summary: After years of fighting over who gets to use the beach, and where, in Walton County, Florida, public-use advocates are calling for a state constitutional amendment to finally settle the matter.

entry.title: Federal civil rights data about students is finally out. It's different under Trump
entry.summary: The Education Department gathers a massive tranche of civil rights data about public school students. It's now available but harder to parse than in the past.

entry.title: Dry eyes are common in women. Here's why you shouldn't ignore them
entry.summary: Research suggests that around half of all women in the menopausal transition years experience symptoms, like red, watery or gritty-feeling eyes. Hormonal shifts play a role, as do many other factors.

entry.title: The price of diesel hits a record high
entry.summary: The price of diesel has reached an all-time high, a result of the war in Iran and Ukraine's attacks on Russian refineries. That will matter across the supply chain.

entry.title: Trump administration pushes to remove tax exemption for private colleges with DEI policies
entry.summary: The Trump administration is proposing a rule that would strip private schools and colleges of their tax-exempt status if they provide targeted help to students based on their race.

entry.title: Argentina's Milei escalates Falklands dispute, seizing on Trump comments and oil tensions
entry.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei is escalating a dispute with Britain over the Falkland Islands with tougher sanctions targeting companies involved in a major offshore oil project

entry.title: 2 trapped workers rescued from a hydropower tunnel 9 days after Nepal floods
entry.summary: Officials say rescuers in Nepal have pulled two workers alive from a tunnel Friday during an ongoing operation. The rescues come nine days after the Aug. 26 floods.
